mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tap_user (username, password_hash, email, role, usernum, classname, phone, department, display_name, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, UPPER(#{role}), #{usernum}, #{classname}, #{phone}, #{department}, #{username}, TRUE, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tap_user SET username = #{username}, password_hash = #{password}, email = #{email}, role = UPPER(#{role}), usernum = #{usernum}, classname = #{classname}, phone = #{phone}, department = #{department}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password AS password, email, LOWER(role) AS role, usernum, classname, phone, department FROM user WHERE username = #{username} AND LOWER(role) = 'student'
